WITH per_operator AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    SUM(scancount) AS total_scans,
    AVG(1.0 * gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
),
operator_averages AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM per_operator
  WHERE avg_gb_per_minute IS NOT NULL
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT p.total_scans, p.avg_gb_per_minute, a.all_operator_avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM per_operator AS p
  CROSS JOIN operator_averages AS a
  WHERE p.avg_gb_per_minute > a.all_operator_avg_gb_per_minute
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_scans) AS avg_total_scans,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute - all_operator_avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_margin_above_all_operator_average
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each operator's average is the unweighted average of per-scan gbsize ÷ spanmin values; rows with either value missing or spanmin zero are excluded. The all-operator average gives each operator with at least one valid per-scan value equal weight.
